written_by: Claude, from the film's narration (Voice Transcribe) and a frame contact sheet, before running the pipeline. Not a trainer's list; test data only.

steps.text: At the carburetor, disconnect the air intake hose, the float chamber vent hose, the fuel tank vent line and the oil pressure safety switch vent line.
Remove the choke control cable at the generator and the accelerator rod.
Remove the muffler inlet pipe at the exhaust manifold.
Remove the clutch return spring and the clutch release rod.
Remove the single bolt securing the front engine support.
Remove the clutch pedal linkage and the clutch cross shaft and housing.
Remove the electrical connections to the headlamps and blackout marker assemblies.
Remove the brush guard bolts and pull the brush guard off.
